digest.component_or_area: store epoch guard for sync and push
propositions: A stale clone with divergent epochs must refuse to merge during sync._union_merge and return without unioning, leaving refs unchanged.
A stale clone with divergent epochs must refuse to merge during push_tickets_branch retry on non-fast-forward rejection, returning immediately without further attempts.
The epoch field in .store-compat.json must be a JSON string opaque to parsing, compared only for byte equality, with format ISO-8601 UTC instant plus random suffix.

All nine rows of the state matrix (record absent/present, epoch absent/present/equal/different/corrupt/unreadable) must abort on mismatch and proceed on compatibility, distinguishing ref-unreadable from file-absent in logs.
Guards must emit logger.warning describing the mismatch and preserve local/remote refs exactly without invoking git merge or re-push after epoch detection.
After a guard-aborted non-fast-forward push, fsck must report DIVERGED and never PUSH_PENDING, and merely-behind clones with matching epochs must still converge via ff-adopt.
